fact: Morocco's Direction generale de la meteorologie (DGM) says its observation draws on satellite images refreshed every ten minutes to track weather systems.
The DGM announced it is now equipped with Meteosat Third Generation data, replacing MSG, which Eumetsat declared fully operational via Eumetcast Europe on 2024-12-04.

SNRT News reports a Moroccan General Directorate of Meteorology spokesman saying it acquired third-generation satellite receivers, with 400 automatic stations and 12 radars, to improve forecast accuracy.
SNRT News reports the General Directorate of Meteorology saying its observation upgrade, including satellite receivers, enables accurate warning bulletins.

Morocco's national meteorology directorate awarded Certi-Trust Africa and Middle East a MAD 48,000 order on 29 October 2025 for a second follow-up audit to maintain its ISO 9001 (2015) quality management certification.
